title: Remove Prefix
statement: Implement `solve(text, prefix)`. If `text` starts with `prefix`, return the remainder. Otherwise return `text` unchanged. Remove the prefix only once. An empty prefix returns `text`.
constraints: Do not remove a match in the middle
hints: Slice off len(prefix) only when the test passes.
A prefix longer than the text fails the test and returns the text.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: removeprefix does this and leaves the string alone when the prefix is absent.

editorial: removeprefix does this and leaves the string alone when the prefix is absent. A replace would also delete a later copy. The contract is one leading removal.
